visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of all fifteen four-panel contact sheets, plus geometric intersection/bounds checks on SVG and mounted native scene coordinates.

limitations: Native Arial text has no bold weight; source SVG is retained unchanged.
Cells intentionally smaller than general architecture-card guidelines: short numeric/node labels remain at 16px at native 500px SVG width.
Non-elbow arrows support native endpoint bindings; complex bends may need manual adjustment after large moves.

visualReview.notes: Shared incoming references and separate rebinding targets are unambiguous.
Distinct outer reference slots, shared inner list, and independent inner mutation remain visible.
Exact counts and input column are readable; no timing claim.
Downward calls, upward returns, and the zero base case are separated.
Nine-call tree has the correct repeated f(2) nodes; cache values match local recursion.
All four buffer states and every index are visible; right-to-left copies preserve values.
Highlighted half-open selection and the two prefix boundaries yield 10.
Intermediate B.next preserves C while A still points at C; final A–B–C links are correct.
Middle bypass, head replacement, tail replacement, and singleton clearing are distinct cases.
One B link reverses; prev/current labels advance without losing the saved C suffix.
Reciprocal arrows use separate lanes; B is visibly detached after removal.
Ring edge returns to head without intersecting nodes; one-lap stopping differs from None termination.
Sorted lanes align key 18 across levels; drop and predecessor stop are correct.
Top marks align with stack height before push, after push, and after pop.
Expected-closer stack has top on the right; mismatch retains the required closing bracket.
Head and tail converge on the final node before both become None.
Physical slots, head, size, modulo write index, and logical FIFO order agree.
Front expiry and weaker-back deletion are separate candidate states; index 3 becomes max.
Equal illustrative hashes lead to one bucket containing distinct string-key records.
Tombstone and never-used states are visually distinct; found and missing probe paths are accurate.

reusability.python: Import via importlib; Figure.text/box/arrow/cells/chain/finish are side-effect-free drawing helpers. main() generates only assigned first twenty. Import tested without file writes.
reusability.native: Set DIAGRAM_PLACEMENTS, DIAGRAM_AUDIT, DIAGRAM_EVIDENCE_DIR for another placement batch; same original SVG grammar. EXCALIDRAW_DEPENDENCIES can point to a separate dependency installation.
